notes: H01 and H02 active runtime candidates previously completed independent final audits with MUST 0 and SHOULD 0.
H03 is the user-approved estate pipeline benchmark; its two-stage development model remains an explicitly documented integration limitation.
The current unified root verification rechecked all three active candidates together with H04-H08.

verified: forward, reverse and deterministic-random state coverage
Physics2D debris and map-specific axis restoration
per-axis raw performance samples and thresholds
continuous fishing and winter open-water policy
normal, light and medium anomaly readability
file dimensions, bytes, SHA-256, source, authorization and D-only paths
cache cleanup and candidate integration boundary

repairs_before_final_audit: Added real runtime portal and trigger authority queries for map-specific axes.
Replaced null non-spatial file dimensions with explicit line-count or byte-size not-applicable records.

verified: 192 forward, 192 reverse and 128 deterministic-random states per estate
buildable free, reserved and no-build authority partitions
per-axis raw performance samples and thresholds
continuous fishing and winter open water
visual topology and map-specific feature readability
index integrity, dimensions, source, authorization, D-only paths and cache cleanup

repairs: Bound ruin_route to a real conditional portal runtime authority and query.
Generated ruin-route collision and memory-clue trigger geometry from authoritative TMX data and tested full interior, boundary and outside probe sets.
Recorded full-cartesian and every-axis raw performance samples, p95, maximum and thresholds.
Moved Godot user and editor roots to isolated D-drive locations and retained benign managed-Windows certificate diagnostics only as filtered build-run evidence.
Raised hard derelict debris collision to 276 cells across all 16 natural quadrants and strengthened anomaly readability to 67 light and 251 medium cells.

known_non_findings: Managed Windows may emit a system CA root-certificate diagnostic while offline Godot map validation still completes all required commands with exit code 0.
H03 retains a two-stage development model and requires a formal integration adapter or a later candidate extension.
Reclaimed, expanded and mature facilities may still contain explicitly marked technical art placeholders.
